test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**another**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the proportion of Indians and Chinese in the global population.
 
• The word in the blank should indicate that among the global population, one out of every six persons is an Indian and another is a Chinese.
 
• "**Another**" fits well as it denotes one more person or thing of the same type mentioned.
 
• Other options ("**either**", "**second**", "**many**") do not fit the context of specifying the two predominant nationalities in the described proportion.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *If we look at the global population, out of every six persons living in this world, one is an Indian and * *another__* * a Chinese. The population of Pakistan is very * *__small__* * and accounts for roughly about one-tenth of China or India. Though China is the largest nation and geographically * *__occupies__* * the largest area among the three nations, its density is the lowest. Scholars point out the one child * *__policy__* * in China in the late 1970s as the major reason for low population growth. They also state that this measure led to a * *__decline__* * in the sex ratio, the proportion of females per 1000 males.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Either **(या): This indicates one or the other of two people or things, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Second **(दूसरा): It indicates something ranked number two, which is not fitting in this context.
 
• **Many **(कई): This would indicate a large number of people but does not specify the intended two nationalities.
